Every heading has at least one row: O1 to O5, A1 to A13, S1 to S7 and D1 to D3, Standards (ST-1 to ST-5), Boundaries (B-1 to B-3), the sandbox section (ENV-1 to ENV-7), the scope sentence (SC-1) and all 11 dated addenda (AD-1 to AD-11). criteria.criterion: Each row has a BRIEF.md line citation whose number matches the quoted requirement and evidence with file:line citations, and a coverage grade of Direct, Partial or Open.

Every row has a grade, and I counted 118 rows: 39 Direct, 49 Partial, 30 Open. This same change added 5 lines to the Unreleased entry, so every CHANGELOG cite after line 21 now points 5 lines too early in this tree. Examples: AD-11 and A9-2 cite CHANGELOG.md:26-30 for sccache's speedup being 'not measured', but those lines are now the new requirements-map entry, and the sccache text is at 31-35. D1-1 cites :212, but '## [0.1.0]' is at :217. O1-1 cites :214, but the walking-skeleton line is at :219. The map itself says the line numbers refer to this same tree.

findings.summary: The map's CHANGELOG.md line citations are off by 5 in this tree. The change grew the changelog entry above the cited text without updating the cites.
findings.evidence: The candidate's CHANGELOG.md has 'The speedup is not measured.' at :35, the first study at :55, the study capability registration at :65 and '## [0.1.0]' at :217. The map cites :30, :50-54, :61 and :212/:214, which are the base tree's positions. AD-11 and A9-2 cite :26-30, which is now the requirements-map entry itself. This contradicts the map's own statement that 'Every file:line here refers to the file as it stands in the same tree as this map' and breaks the evidence default. The fix is to add 5 to each CHANGELOG cite above line 21's entry boundary, that is, every cite after line 21.

summary: This change fails on one citation problem. It does what the retry asked: every BRIEF.md requirement section has a row (118 rows, graded Direct, Partial or Open), and a new strategy view and roadmap sit beside the map. I recounted the totals (39 Direct, 49 Partial, 30 Open), the per-theme counts and the roadmap's seven tiers (79 items), and all of them match. The BRIEF.md line numbers match their quotes. cargo test and clippy pass, and only docs and CHANGELOG.md changed. The problem: the change made the changelog entry 5 lines longer, which pushed everything below it down, but the map's citations into CHANGELOG.md were not updated. About nine rows now point 5 lines too early, and two of them point at the new map entry itself instead of the sccache 'not measured' text. The map says its line numbers are correct for this tree, so this breaks the evidence default. Adding 5 to each changelog cite after line 21 would fix it.
